input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 provides automatic one-year renewals (renewal term length is acceptable) but requires ninety (90) days' written notice to avoid renewal. That exceeds the fallback ceiling of 60 days, so it fails the fallback on a material term, though it stops short of walk-away territory (windows longer than 90 days or multi-year renewals). We propose the minimal edit to the preferred 30-day window, with 60 days available as a fallback. There is no renewal price-uplift language in the Agreement, so no cap is required; the absence of a vendor renewal reminder is noted only, not flagged.

proposal.summary: Shorten non-renewal notice window from 90 to 30 days
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have shortened the non-renewal notice window from ninety (90) to thirty (30) days so either party can exit an automatic one-year renewal on 30 days' notice, consistent with our playbook position; we can accept up to 60 days if HDI needs additional lead time.

ops.oldText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other
ops.newText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon thirty (30) days written notice to the other
